description.value: Freshslice Pizza is a BC-founded pizza chain known for its any-toppings flat-price model, serving pizza by the slice and whole pies for dine-in or takeout. This Burnaby location on Royal Oak Avenue is a strip-mall fast-food stop with indoor seating and no drive-through. For a touring cyclist it offers a quick, filling, and affordable calorie stop in a suburban Burnaby corridor.
